what: Over the full photo panel, a small square panel (214px) with the next photo follows the cursor (its top left corner) by 25% of the remaining distance each frame (the mouse position is remembered across the whole window, so it still appears when the panel rolls in under that spot), and it grows by 20% per frame only when it fits entirely inside the panel (when it touches an edge it shrinks to a single point 64px inward). On press, that small panel grows in place to fill the screen over 1s with cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) and becomes the next photo, and the new small panel (the photo after that) grows again from 0 over .8s after .2s. On touch devices, you press an 80×96 panel at the right center to advance

options.size: Side length of the small tile (px), default 214
options.msize: Small panel size on touch devices (width x height), default 80x96
options.grow: Duration for the new small panel to grow (s), default .8
options.follow: Fraction trailing in per frame, default .25

note: Fires fx:change(detail.index) on each switch. The cursor label (”Next”) is attached separately by the user side.

from.where: index.html .e-car (service bay photo slider — original is a CursorCarousel drawn on canvas)
